title: Stage 3: upgrade to Papyrus 5.87.0 and verify the contentNeededKey index
description:
What: bump the four pins to 5.87.0 together (package.json, infra/package.json, infra/site.json papyrusVersion, requirements-publication.txt), refresh both lock files, open a pull request into main. Deploy alone: nothing else ships in this merge. Wait for the contentNeededKey index to be ACTIVE on the Reference table, then run the verification list on the epic and (for the feed keys) any backfill the Papyrus 5.87.0 release notes require. Papyrus's own upgrade-planner story (PPY-d2cab9) may automate this later.
Acceptance:
Scenario: The stage deploys alone and the index becomes active
  Given Distinctive is on the previous stage
  When the pin pull request for 5.87.0 is merged
  Then the deploy is green and the contentNeededKey index is ACTIVE
Scenario: The public site is unchanged
  Given the sitemap and sample pages from the previous stage
  Then they match after the deploy
